description: Restores a backup of an app's data, the whole copy. Restore (and undo) replace all the data, owner only, with confirm; before a restore the current data is sealed 7 days and action "undo" puts it back. Runs in the background: poll backups_read. More: neblla_get_llms tools/backups

confirm.description: Set true to run the irreversible action

confirmEmpty.description: For restore: only to empty the app on purpose

date.description: For restore: the day of the copy, YYYY-MM-DD

force.description: For replay_held: also apply the writes of players who saved

key.description: For replay_held: the `key` of one of list's `held` packages

name: neblla_backups
title: Backups
